title: UTM Campaign/Source/Medium Tracking Fields and sale.order Linkage
key_finding: UTM mixin injects campaign_id/source_id/medium_id onto sale.order, crm.lead, hr.applicant, link.tracker, and account.move (via sale addon); cookies capture URL params for 31 days; all UTM records are cross-company shared with no revenue fields in core module.

fields.name: Char — computed unique identifier slug from title, UNIQUE constraint
fields.title: Char — human-readable display name (_rec_name)
fields.is_auto_campaign: Boolean — True when auto-created from URL param

utm.campaign.notes: No company_id. Stage cannot be deleted while campaigns reference it.

utm.source.notes: Referral cannot be deleted. UtmSourceMixin abstract model auto-creates sources for email/social posts.

fields.name: Char — plain text, no _compute_name, UNIQUE constraint

utm.medium.notes: No _compute_name(). Name is plain Char. _fetch_or_create_utm_medium() helper for programmatic create.

utm.stage.notes: Always-install (not demo). ACL: regular users read-only.

utm.tag.notes: ACL: regular users read-only. Linked to campaigns via utm_tag_rel M2M.

utm.mixin.notes: default_get() skips salesman group (sales_team.group_sale_salesman). Reads cookies to pre-populate fields. _find_or_create_record() auto-creates UTM lookups.

sale.order.invoice_propagation: UTM triplet copied to account.move at _prepare_invoice() (lines 1433-1435)

account.move.notes: UTM on account.move is installed by sale addon, NOT base account addon. UTM preserved on _reverse_moves() (credit notes).

revenue_fields.notes: No revenue/amount/turnover field on any UTM model in Community. Attribution via account.move UTM fields requires external BI aggregation.

company_scope.notes: All UTM models (campaign, source, medium, stage, tag) have no company_id. Shared across all companies in multi-company deployments.

claims.claim: utm.campaign stores two name fields (computed slug identifier + human-readable title), owner, stage, colour, tags, auto-flag, and active status.
utm.mixin adds campaign_id, source_id, medium_id (all btree_not_null indexed Many2one) to consumer models.
default_get() reads browser cookies to auto-populate UTM fields; skips salesman group; auto-creates lookup records from string values.
ir.http._post_dispatch captures utm_campaign/source/medium URL params as 31-day optional cookies per request.
sale.order inherits utm.mixin with set-null override; UTM triplet propagates to account.move during _prepare_invoice().
Five Community models use utm.mixin: sale.order, account.move (via sale addon), crm.lead, hr.applicant, link.tracker.
utm.stage has name and sequence; one always-install default stage 'New'; stage deletion blocked by campaigns; kanban shows all stages.
Core UTM module has no revenue/amount fields; attribution only through account.move UTM fields via sale addon.
All UTM models are cross-company shared (no company_id); utm.medium.name is a plain Char (no _compute_name); utm.campaign has tag_ids M2M to utm.tag.
